greeting: Hello! Let me check which welfare schemes you qualify for.
ask_annual_income: What is your family's total income in one year?
ask_gender: Are you a woman or a man?
ask_category: Which category do you belong to: SC, ST, OBC or general?
ask_district: Which district do you live in?
ask_is_student: Are you studying in class 11 or above right now?
ask_owns_farmland: Is there farm land in your own name?
ask_pays_income_tax: Do you or your husband or wife pay income tax?
ask_govt_job_or_big_pension: Do you or your husband or wife have a government job, or a pension of 10,000 rupees a month or more?
ask_is_family_head: Are you the head of the family on your ration card?
eligible: {title}: you qualify. Reason: {reasons}. Source: {source}, in force from {date}.

check_others: I can check other schemes for you too.
ask_proceed: Shall I start filling the application form?
proceed_declined: Okay. Tell me when you want to apply.
confirm_ask: Shall I submit your application for {title}? Say yes to submit.
readback_unsure: I wasn't fully sure I heard this right: {fields}.
confirm_reask: Please say yes to submit, or no to stop.
